name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Toronto-based junior mining company focused on advancing its flagship Diablillos silver-gold project, a 79-square-kilometre property in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a large Measured and Indicated resource of approximately 102 Mt at 65 g/t silver equivalent, with the company advancing toward a feasibility study and construction decision. AbraSilver is in the advanced exploration and development stage, also trading on the OTCQX under the ticker ABBRF.
